_comment: Copy to tables/resources.json (git-ignored; holds real SSH targets / tailnet addresses) and edit, then point the router at it with CORTADOS_LOCAL_RESOURCES_CONFIG. Each node is sampled over SSH (target 'local' means this machine); the collector reports unified/VRAM memory and GPU headroom. 'inventory' is documentation only. 'deployments' stays empty until a model is verified on real hardware (see docs/LOCAL-RESOURCES.md). Addresses here are placeholders.

nodes._comment: No ollama block: the Studio runs S1 only and offers no chat models (owner 2026-11-13, #75).

ollama._comment: Local models live on the Pro only (#75; owner 2026-11-13: the Studio runs S1, no chat models). The URL is the Pro's local gate (http://<pro tailscale-ip>:11435), from the env var named here (or base_url); the token file path likewise. Never commit a real address or token. The gate refuses on battery or with the manual switch off (local_resources toggle), and the lane is skipped then. The models are the ones already on the Pro (owner 2026-11-13: nothing is downloaded for the router). auto_route stays false (pin-only) until the owner names the bands; the recommended first setting is {"model": "qwen-27b", "bands": ["R0"]} (Qwen27b_heretic; Huihui_Qwen_9b is the fast/small option) (docs/LOCAL-RESOURCES.md, Local auto-route). context_length must not exceed the Pro's OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH. Model ids carry the tag exactly as `ollama list` prints it (e.g. Qwen27b_heretic:latest); the provider also treats `name` and `name:latest` as the same model. Each model may set thinking: "off-unless-asked" (the default: a request that did not ask for thinking is sent with thinking disabled, #108) or "passthrough".
ollama.label: Pro
